item.title: Northeastern introduces artificial intelligence combined majors, renames undergraduate data science programs
item.description:
# Northeastern introduces artificial intelligence combined majors, renames undergraduate data science programs This fall, Northeastern will [roll out 24](https://www.khoury.northeastern.edu/current-undergraduate-students/bs-in-data-science-to-bs-in-ai-transition-faq/) artificial intelligence, or AI, [combined majors](https://admissions.northeastern.edu/academics/combined-majors/), which will replace its undergraduate [data science majors](https://catalog.northeastern.edu/undergraduate/computer-information-science/data-science/).
The majors include AI combined with mathematics, biochemistry and journalism.
(The university also offers a [Master of Science in AI](https://www.khoury.northeastern.edu/programs/artificial-intelligence-ms/), but said its [Master of Science in data science](https://www.khoury.northeastern.edu/programs/data-science-ms/) will not be impacted.)
The Bachelor of Science in AI “explores the design, development, and application of intelligent systems that learn, reason, and act,” according to the major’s [page](https://www.khoury.northeastern.edu/programs/artificial-intelligence-bs/#campus-location). The program is a combination of computer science, statistics and probability theory, including a “rigorous focus” on AI ethics.
Wentworth Institute of Technology, Endicott College and Suffolk University will all introduce AI degree programs in the next two years, according to reporting from the [Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/08/16/metro/artificial-intelligence-degrees/).
Northeastern also offers an [AI Applications Certificate](https://graduate.northeastern.edu/programs/certg-ai-applications/graduate-certificate-in-ai-applications/) program, which teaches AI fundamentals and application strategies.
- [AI](https://huntnewsnu.com/tag/ai/)
